title: Capability adapter factory lazy binding contract (L54-reframed)
description: Defer adapter import + construct until first invocation. See ADR-041.

new_api.signature: register_executor_factory(capability_id: str, factory: Callable[[], Any]) -> None

invariants.name: factory_signature
invariants.description: register_executor_factory(capability_id, factory). Factory returns adapter instance on first call.
must: method exists on CapabilityRegistry
factory is Callable[[], Any] (no args, returns adapter)
factory called at most twice per cap_id (first construct + retry on .available)

invariants.name: defer_import_and_construct
invariants.description: Factory MUST defer BOTH the adapter module import and the class instantiation.
must: no `from waggledance.adapters.capabilities.X import Y` at module level in bootstrap/capability_loader.py for adapters in _ADAPTERS table
factory closure performs the import lazily on call
no AdapterX() at register time

invariants.name: first_call_construction
invariants.description: First get_executor(cap_id) triggers factory call. Subsequent return cached.
must: first call: factory invoked, result stored in _executors
subsequent calls: O(1) dict lookup, no factory invocation
factory call count == 1 per cap_id under normal operation

invariants.name: available_check_at_first_use
invariants.description: If executor.available is False, cap_id added to _factory_failed; None returned. Subsequent calls short-circuit.
must: _factory_failed set tracks unavailable cap_ids
second call for failed cap_id returns None without re-running factory
matches existing 'unavailable adapter skipped' semantics

invariants.name: exception_safe
invariants.description: Factory exceptions caught + logged at DEBUG + cap_id added to _factory_failed. No propagation.
must: try/except wraps factory() call
exception type and message logged at DEBUG level
caller of get_executor never sees the exception
subsequent calls short-circuit via _factory_failed (no retry storm)

invariants.name: no_regression_on_eager_api
invariants.description: Existing register_executor(cap_id, executor) still works for callers that need eager binding.
must: old API preserved, no signature change
old API call populates _executors directly (not _executor_factories)
tests that depend on register_executor continue to pass

invariants.name: boot_saving_target
invariants.description: Lazy bind_executors() must complete in < 100 ms (target_lazy_bind_ms).
must: regression test asserts cold bind_executors() < 100 ms
compare to baseline ~6855 ms eager
99%+ reduction expected

out_of_scope: Migration of direct register_executor callers (none identified)
Predictive eager-warm-up at boot (future ADR if benefit measured)
